withdrawn_claim.reason: no source read supports the clause. design_arithmetic.model: within-county paired binary comparison on dual-coded colorectal cases, each case carrying both NAACCR 762 and NAACCR 764; margin delta = 0.427713625866 pp on the code-9 share difference
design_arithmetic.formula: n = ( z_{1-alpha/2} * sqrt(d) + z_{1-beta} * sqrt(d - delta^2) )^2 / delta^2, d = p01 + p10 total discordance, Connor form for paired proportions
design_arithmetic.settings: alpha 0.05 two-sided (z 1.959963984540054), power 0.80 (z 0.8416212335729143); one-sided variant substitutes z 1.6448536269514722
design_arithmetic.reading: the margin is resolvable within the Harris pool only if total 762-against-764 discordance on colorectal cases is at or below 2.019 per cent two-sided (2.563 per cent one-sided). Above that the required pairs exceed the county: at 5 per cent discordance the design needs 2.48 times the entire Harris colorectal pool. A census of both counties returns the excess exactly and needs no inference; a sample-based dual-coding study is not feasible at any plausible discordance.

closure_test_revision.population: adults 45-74 with a first primary invasive colorectal carcinoma resident at diagnosis in Hinds County MS (FIPS 28049) and Harris County TX (FIPS 48201), diagnoses 2019-2023
closure_test_revision.comparator: the same case coded under NAACCR 762 and under NAACCR 764; the county contrast is the second comparison and is not replaced
closure_test_revision.primary_outcome_of_this_limb: the derived-minus-direct code-9 share difference in Harris, printed beside the derived-minus-direct late share difference, the three integers per county (late, localized, unstaged) and the late-stage rate per 100000 person-years; the pilot primary outcome, completed diagnostic follow-up at 180 days after an abnormal screening-indication colorectal test, remains UNMEASURED at both counties, is reported beside these numbers and is never replaced by them, and a test ordered is not a completed action
closure_test_revision.what_closes_it: one central-registry extract per state under a data-use agreement carrying both NAACCR 762 and NAACCR 764 on colorectal cases, which supplies the three integers and the cross-tabulation in one pass; the public-download route is withdrawn
closure_test_revision.resources_and_authority: one extract per state from the Mississippi State Department of Health and the Texas Cancer Registry at DSHS, both items requested explicitly in the data request, one analyst-week, one named human analyst who signs the extract, no IRB action for aggregate cells; the dual-coding arm no longer needs a separate data-use agreement because it rides the same extract
closure_test_revision.harms: none to patients; the interpretive harm is quoting 0.2723 pp as measured when the publication supports 0.20 to 0.38 pp, and the inverse harm is retiring a real difference the published grain cannot see; the second-order harm is a study design that cannot answer its own falsification condition and would burn an extract to learn that
closure_test_revision.equity: at county-aggregate grain this limb can neither detect nor conceal a within-county disparity; the county label proxies registry programme, submission stream and stage-variable production process; race enters nothing and proxies nothing here
closure_test_revision.sustainment: the gate is deterministic, offline, sub-second and re-runnable at any vintage; the break-even discordance is a published number the extract can be checked against before any analysis
closure_test_revision.falsification_condition: the practical consequence of C-S864-2 is falsified if the observed derived-minus-direct code-9 excess is below 0.427713625866 pp; the derived-minus-direct excess itself is falsified as a material mechanism if it is below one case at the Harris denominator (0.011547344110 pp) on a complete dual-coded census
closure_test_revision.smallest_test: the two-item extract on the county census; it settles the sign, the construct and the volume question together
